verdict.rationale: Thoropass's official MCP server docs say the assistant works 'within limits you set,' and that you can 'add or remove the last three depending on what you want your agent to be able to do.' This implies configurable scopes for agent access, and the documented actions range from read-only listing of audits and evidence requests to writing comments and status updates. The evidence never describes issuing dedicated API credentials or tokens, what the scope options are, or how least privilege is enforced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-specific API keys or tokens, a defined permission or scope model for those credentials, read-only versus write scope separation, credential rotation or revocation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
